parameters: Read the six five-severity grids from the frozen base protocol; 33 conditions including clean and two sensor dropouts.
application: On resized RGB sensor content in float32 [0,1], before tensor inference; preserve letterbox padding. Never round corrupted pixels back to uint8.

blur.kernel: separable Gaussian; radius ceil(3*sigma), size 2*ceil(3*sigma)+1; normalize float64 coefficients then cast to float32
blur.padding: reflect without repeating the edge pixel: NumPy reflect / OpenCV BORDER_REFLECT_101

thermal_contrast: mu + alpha*(image-mu), with mu the scalar mean of resized content over all pixels/channels (float64 accumulation, cast to float32)

noise.seed_digest: SHA-256; first 16 bytes interpreted as unsigned big-endian integer
noise.generator: NumPy Generator(PCG64(seed)); standard_normal(shape) float64 draw cast to float32 before scaling
noise.independence: independent pixels/channels; seed independent of worker, iteration order and fusion method

dropout: Return None before image preparation; omit detector call and candidate. Apply missing features later using the training-fitted cap.
labels: Do not change paired presence, sensor visibility or sensor-native ground truth.
freeze_gate: Unit tests, visual examples for all families/severities, and a small validation-only inference smoke check; record code/config/environment hashes. No full dataset run needed to validate the operators.

validation.freeze_changes: Only frozen-status and evidence metadata added after validation; operator parameters and implementation unchanged.
validation.scope: 3 validation frame pairs, 33 conditions, 192 model calls, 6 dropout skips; numerical/visual smoke only, no robustness-performance claim.
